title: Lumas new creative agents are a huge leap forward in AI creative production #freeonlinetools #ai
description:
Lumas new creative agents are a huge leap forward in AI creative production Instead of creating individual assets the platform orchestrates several subagents to perform individual tasks simultaneously choosing the best model for the taskathand It blew my mind in early testing My motherinlaw wanted to create a YouTube video explaining simple stock trading techniques to young adults using cartoon characters that each represented a candlestick pattern I explained to her that the process would require hundreds of individual image generations for each character followed by imagetovideo variations for each VO SFX and music would be required as well before stitching it all together That process would have taken hours and hours across several different programs and models But Luma nailed it in one take from a simple prompt 15 mins later we had a 10 minute Youtube video that looked and sounded great with perfect accuracy across all candlestick patterns Now you can see why I think multiagent orchestration is the future of creative production LumaPartner Luma
Roberto Nickson
